renderer_path: GitHub /markdown endpoint followed by the live github.com math-renderer custom element

forbidden_commands.operatorname: GitHub's live math component reports: The following macros are not allowed: operatorname. Use a tested alternative such as \mathrm for a short fixed label.

markdown_escape_hazards.,: The Markdown layer converts \, to a literal comma before math rendering.
markdown_escape_hazards.!: The Markdown layer converts \! to a literal exclamation mark before math rendering.
markdown_escape_hazards.;: The Markdown layer converts \; to a literal semicolon before math rendering.
markdown_escape_hazards.:: The Markdown layer converts \: to a literal colon before math rendering.
